data.title: Vida Residences
data.about:
Vida Residences at Dubai Hills Estate stands as a beacon of community vitality, encouraging a life rich in creativity and social interaction within the tranquil setting of Dubai Hills. Vida Residences invites diverse experiences, from peaceful gatherings in communal areas to lively events, all designed to foster moments of inspiration and connectivity. 

With an array of residential options that blend artistry with practical elegance, from cozy 1 to 3 bedroom apartments and luxurious 3 -bedroom townhouses, there's something for every dynamic and imaginative individual. The Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate address is a sought-after location for those looking to immerse in this creative lifestyle.

The estate offers a perfect mix of modernity and comfort, reflecting Vida's minimalist and innovative style alongside the luxury of Dubai Hills Estate. Each living space aims to inspire freedom and joy, balancing luxury with functionality. The modern exteriors, a symbol of contemporary luxury, complement the natural allure of Dubai Hills Park, making it a prime location for those interested in Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate for sale.

This development is the epitome of lifestyle elegance, with panoramic views over the lush Dubai Hills Park. It provides a tranquil yet vibrant backdrop for everyday living, merging the serenity of the park with the dynamic atmosphere of the Hills Mall.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Leisure & Luxury at Vida Residences by Emaar
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Lifestyle Excellence: Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate exemplifies the Vida spirit of living a life full of inspiration and creativity.
  • Unmatched Views: Offers direct, vast views of the verdant expanse of Dubai Hills Park, enhancing the living experience at Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate.
  • Unparalleled Elegance: Set amidst the tranquil surroundings of Dubai Hills Estate, Vida Residences combine classical beauty with modern conveniences seamlessly.
  • Prime Location: Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate boasts a central location within Dubai Hills Estate, a short drive from major key locations.
  • Amenities Par Excellence: Boasts state-of-the-art amenities, elevating the lifestyle at Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate.
  • Residential Mastery: Offers elegant apartments ranging from 1 to 3-bedroom units, and 3-bedroom townhouses, showcasing the diversity of living options available for rent or purchase at Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate.
  • Architectural Beauty: 23 stories of sleek, modern design at Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate, providing unparalleled views of Dubai Hills Park.
  • Luxurious Interiors: Features open-plan designs, handpicked natural materials, and breathtaking floor-to-ceiling windows, encapsulating the essence of luxury living.
  • Nearby Attractions: Vida Residences is moments away from attractions like Dubai Hills Park, Dubai Hills Mall, and Dubai Hills Golf Club.

location_tile.title: Perfect Location at Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Surrounded by the peaceful Dubai Hills Park, the vibrant Dubai Hills Mall, and the prestigious championship golf course, Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate stands as a beacon of high-quality living and convenience. It's a place where leisure activities, shopping experiences, and sports facilities are all within easy access, making it the ultimate location for those prioritizing essential amenities close by. 

Dubai Hills Estate seamlessly blends lifestyle and convenience, offering everything from leisurely escapes in Dubai Hills Park—ideal for unwinding or family fun—to a variety of living options. Whether you're interested in purchasing or renting at Vida Residences Dubai Hills Estate, exploring the luxurious offerings of Vida Residence Emirates Hills, or considering the sale of Vida Emirates Hills apartments, this community ensures a life where convenience meets luxury at every corner.

  • 05-minute drive to Kings College Hospital
  • 05-minute walk to Dubai Hills Business Park
  • 06-minute walk to Mosque
  • 08-minute walk to Dubai Hills Mall
  • 12-minute drive to Downtown Dubai
